decisionRationale: The 2016 English Grand Central work family is the dominant canonical edition visible across official and bibliographic sources.
Open Library supplies the full chapter map and stable print identifiers needed for chapter numbering.
The Hachette and Google Books listings describe the same work family and do not indicate revised, abridged, or reordered chapter content.
No translation or edition ambiguity was found that would materially change chapter count, order, or chapter-level interpretation.
